decision_question: Does the archived pinned implementation's covariance point estimate have correctly matched uncertainty under a Gaussian infinitesimal summary-Z model with exact LD?
reported_overlap_intercept: Exact truth; separate algebraic perturbations are diagnostics, not an empirical source estimate
LD_model: V_ij=a^abs(i-j), exact deterministic PSD correlation; L2_i=sum_j V_ij^2; no reference-panel sampling noise or clipping
summary_model: Independent eigenmodes with Var(tZ1_j)=d_j+n1*h1*d_j^2/m; Var(tZ2_j)=d_j+n2*h2*d_j^2/m; Cov(tZ1_j,tZ2_j)=sqrt(n1*n2)*rho*d_j^2/m+c*d_j. Four independent equal-sized blocks provide chromosome-context h2 estimates. Correlated Gaussian draws constructed by scalar conditional representation with explicit PSD checks.
implementations: Exact pinned upstream calLocalCov executed on truth-known dense LD and synthetic summary statistics for limited concordance fixtures
Separate vectorized reconstruction of the same expressions for Monte Carlo
Independent analytic variance of the returned moment estimator: [sum Var1_j*Var2_j + sum Cov12_j^2] / [n1*n2*meanLD^2]
Independent full-eigenspace oracle GLS covariance estimator and uncertainty as a null-model benchmark
reported_statistics: empirical rejection counts and Wilson 95% intervals
mean estimated covariance and Monte Carlo SE
missing and out-of-bounds derived correlation counts
limitations: Synthetic Gaussian summary statistics are not real genotypes or native GWAS replay
Exact LD excludes reference noise, source meta-analysis missingness, binary ascertainment and real ancestry mismatch
Fixed truth overlap bypasses genome-wide intercept estimation and its uncertainty
10000 simulations have limited precision at the frozen 0.05/8465 tail; no certified empirical FWER calibration claim
Parameters are illustrative diagnostic scenarios, not empirically identified Brain6 LD or local heritability truth
Simulation failure is a source-specific concern requiring native-data and expert review, not an estimate of actual Brain6 false positives
resource_cap: Single process; OPENBLAS_NUM_THREADS=OMP_NUM_THREADS=MKL_NUM_THREADS=1; batches128; 160x160 LD; no participant data; output <5MB
stopping_rule: Execute all 24 prespecified scenarios; retain every failure; no significance-seeking adaptive expansion. Native concordance failure stops simulation inference until fixed.
